description: 兵在5线 — 黑方车可直接6线拦截，白方无法推进

intro.popup_en: With the pawn on the fifth rank, Black can stop it directly with the rook on the sixth rank. White cannot make progress and must settle for exchanging rooks.
intro.popup: 兵在5线，黑方车直接6线拦截白方难以推进，只好简单换车。

outro.popup_en: Draw. The black rook blocks the pawn from the sixth rank while the black king holds the key squares.
outro.popup:
和棋
黑车直接6线拦截，黑王守住关键位置，黑方成功防守。

moves.popup_en: The black rook blocks the pawn directly from the sixth rank.
White recognizes there is no breakthrough and offers an exchange.
moves.popup: <b>白方知道无法突破， 直接换车。

moves.popup_en: The black king protects the position, and the game is drawn.
